thread:
maya: quick RFC follow-up — proposal to add a `scope_projections` claim at token mint time so runtime doesn't have to expand org/project role graphs on every request. idea is: compute projection once, include it as a compact claim, verify at request time.

sam: hmm, sounds promising for latency. how big do you expect the claim to be? any blowup risk for large orgs?

maya: good q. prototype shows ~200-800 bytes for typical apps (roles + derived perms). worst-case with hundreds of roles could be a few KB. still cheaper than a DB/graph lookup per request.

jordan: what about revocation / rollouts? if a role changes we need tokens to reflect that. do we rely on short TTLs or a revocation list?

maya: TTL + revocation list hybrid. tokens get a max TTL (e.g., 1h for service-to-service). for long-running worker flows we issue short-lived child tokens via an exchange that re-evaluates projections.

lina: is this compatible with current RBAC model? projection generation needs the same policy engine, right? we can't duplicate logic in two places long-term.

maya: correct — projection generation calls the canonical policy engine (same code path as current runtime expansion). the only duplication is the claim serializer. goal: single source of truth for policies, projection is just materialized output.

sam: security tradeoffs? stronger tokens mean more sensitive if leaked. must ensure KMS+auditing and maybe flag tokens as non-refreshable for certain scopes.

maya: agreed — require rotation and bound tokens by audience and origin. we can add an `origins` claim and `non_refreshable` boolean. also recommend HSM-backed signing for production.

jordan: migration path thoughts? can't flip on across the fleet. propose opt-in per service with dual verification: runtime accepts `scope_projections` when present, else falls back to legacy expansion. run opt-in for 2-3 weeks and measure.

lina: perf metrics to watch: p95 auth latency, CPU on auth-service, token size distribution, cache hit rate. also telemetry for projection mismatches (token projection vs current policy) — surface as alert.

ops-bot: deploy note: canary rollout window scheduled if PR lands. :white_check_mark:

maya: action items: (1) draft small RFC w/ claim schema + TL;DR (I'll do), (2) add dual-verify shim in auth middleware (sam+jordan), (3) prototype projection serializer & size tests (lina), (4) telemetry hooks + revocation design (ops + security).

sam: +1 on owner for middleware, will start a branch for dual-verify.

jordan: I'll help add test fixtures for big org graphs. want to simulate edge blowups.

lina: will stub telemetry events, sending to auth-metrics.

maya: thanks. let's reconvene after the RFC draft — aiming EOW. :rocket:

sam: ack.

jordan: ack.

lina: ack.
